item.description:
## 🔄 Retail User – Get List of Transactions Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token | Obtain an access token using client or user credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2 | Search for Account ID | (Optional) Use this step to find the account ID if it is not already known. |
| 3 | Get List of Transactions | Retrieve the list of transactions linked to the specified account. |

item.description:
## 🔄 Business User – Get List of Accounts Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token | Obtain an access token using client or user credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2 | Search for Business Entity | (Optional) Use this step to locate the institution customer ID if it’s not already available. Retrieve business user details and match the memberNumber (TIN/EIN) to identify the corresponding institutionCustomerId. |
| 3 | Search for Account ID | (Optional) Use this step to find the account ID if it is not already known. |
| 4 | Get List of Transactions | Retrieve the list of transactions linked to the specified account. |
